own_solution.law: Closed-open pipe f = c/(4 L_eff), c proportional to sqrt(T), L_eff fixed by tuning; beat = f (sqrt(T2/T1) - 1)
assumptions: L_eff and fork frequency independent of temperature

defect_reasons.other: The R sentences ('before the pipe is tuned, the fork is pitched higher by a further 62 Hz') sit awkwardly beside the base text's 'exactly the frequency 440 Hz of a tuning fork'; read as an intervention on the fork it is consistent, but the wording is slightly artificial.

notes: Verified: sqrt(301/288) - 1 = 0.0223203; base beat 440*0.0223203 = 9.8209 Hz; R answers 475, 502, 531 Hz times 0.0223203 = 10.602, 11.205, 11.852 Hz, all matching. End correction cancels since L_eff is fixed by tuning (C claim correct). K regime: Leff = c1/(4f) with c1 = 340.19 m/s gives 0.1933 m; 600*47 um = 0.028 m inside; 6e4 um outside, as claimed. Minimal pairs T056D/T9D97 (earlier experiment vs this tuning, fork) and T3EBE/TFAFF (guitar string vs fork) share 62 Hz and differ only in attachment. T41CC and T54B8 are numeral-free controls by design. Agrees with pass 1.
